text: Aloha Township is a civil township located in Cheboygan County, Michigan. As of the 2020 census, the population was 937. The township has a total area of 32.38 square miles (83.86 km²), of which 29.50 square miles (76.40 km²) is land and 2.88 square miles (7.46 km²), or 8.89%, is water. According to the U.S. Census Bureau, as of the 2000 census, there were 1,041 people, 423 households, and 321 families residing in the township. The population density was 35.4 inhabitants per square mile (13.7/km²), with 670 housing units at an average density of 22.8 per square mile (8.8/km²). The racial makeup was 95.29% White, 2.50% Native American, 0.38% Asian, 0.10% from other races, and 1.73% from two or more races. Hispanic or Latino of any race made up 0.38% of the population. Of the 423 households, 27.0% had children under 18, 70.0% were married couples living together, 3.5% had a female householder with no husband present, and 23.9% were non-families; 19.9% of households consisted of individuals, and 9.5% had someone living alone who was 65 years or older. The average household size was 2.45, and the average family size was 2.80. The age distribution showed 23.8% under 18, 3.8% from 18 to 24, 23.0% from 25 to 44, 30.7% from 45 to 64, and 18.6% aged 65 or older, with a median age of 45. For every 100 females, there were 105.3 males, and for every 100 females age 18 and over, there were 106.5 males. The median household income was $34,853, and the median family income was $41,406. Males had a median income of $32,955, while females earned $22,206. The per capita income was $18,656. Approximately 9.6% of families and 13.9% of the population were below the poverty line, including 17.1% of those under 18 and 8.9% of those 65 or older.
